findings.description: 数据来源 PISCES cull list 与 task.md HARD 数据源一致，无偏移
baseline_hairpin_rate=1.0 for all 197 paired chains — exceeds ≥0.7 threshold
N=197 paired chains; effect size Δ=-0.862 means power >>0.99
Donor pool (100 chains) strictly non-overlapping with main set (200 chains); donor native DSSP verified no hairpin at target residue positions
is_hairpin_region() pure function; DSSP run on ESMFold predicted structure only (mkdssp on output_to_pdb output); no native structure contamination
patch_s_at_blocks() correctly implements block-input pre-hook clone-then-replace with block-specific donor tensors; hook cleanup via handle.remove() prevents leakage
Three specificity controls correctly implemented: z-patching same window, matched-ctrl non-target mask, late-window s-patching (implicit from band coverage)
cath_label=null for all chains in manifest; CATH mapping was attempted but not written. Does not affect main experiment. Reduces dataset variant stratification to a single group.

32 tests (8 bands × 4 conditions) without Bonferroni/FDR correction. Given the 13:1 ratio between early s-patch effect (Δ=-0.862) and all controls (max Δ=-0.067), no correction would reverse the conclusion.
